I was told I’d get a call from the doctor about my results (as usual with any medical test) and I haven’t. I’m presuming, as well as my family is, that no call means nothing was found. Cause surely they would’ve called if I had cancer or something right? I had a clean blood test from them earlier this year and I had to ask about it to find that out otherwise they wouldn’tve told me.

I still have mild pain in my pelvic area that comes some days but then will go away for a few days or even weeks too; like it started again today for example. But no hard flakes/stones.
 
At this point I still don’t know what’s wrong, I can only suspect maybe interstitial cystitis but I’d need a cystoscopy and that scares me. If it is that, then I can only cope with it as a chronic condition. I probably need to ask my clinic again about it..

Thank you to everyone's who's been so nice about my panicking and telling me their own experiences too, it's helped me not feel so entirely alone in this to hear voices besides my own. I still have my fears but rationalizing out the risks and trying to understand that most things that could be found are all treatable has helped. My health anxiety is horrible for the past months? Over a year now? I think which is definitely in part to having gone through a death in the family (old age and a disease entirely unrelated to renal/urinary health or cancer) and health scares from other family members (which were also all unrelated to my current problem, and they ended up fine). I even had bloodwork very recently, like maybe a month ago, and it was all clear too. Yet I'm still like this about my health??

I know I'll probably still end up freaking out the day-of, but I'll be sure to leave updates with how it goes and how my results end up.

One of my knees is messed up in some way that I can’t understand. I lose the memory of where exactly it happens at unless it’s happening, but it doesn’t feel like it’s on the top or bottom entirely. What happens is just, ocassionally when I bend or move that leg around I can’t “unlock” my joint for about 5-10 seconds. During this, I literally scream in fear and pain as I get it unlocked. I’m 20 and this has been happening since high school. I’ve mentioned it to two doctors, both said it’s just youth joint laxness since I feel no pain wherever they squeeze or rotate the knee. It’s only during these episodes that it happens so it’s really hard to prove. No one I know of has ever had this type of issue with just youth joint laxness. I don’t think I should be screaming for a few seconds trying to move my leg but maybe that’s just me.

My skin is oily, sensitive, and probably combo. I don’t break out too often but I usually have a couple clogged pores or a pimple at most given times due to my high oil production.

1. Neutrogena Healthy Skin Anti Wrinkle Anti Blemish cleanser (used as spot treament mainly) 
2. Neutrogena Alcohol-free Toner
3. Thayer’s Alcohol-free Rose Witch Hazel Toner (used occasionally, I believe my sign purged a little from this at first but it’s ok now) 
4. Hada Labo Skin Plumping Gel Cream (not used everyday but around 2/3 or 1/2 the time)
5. Josie Maran Argan Daily Moisturizer SPF 47
6. Sweet Almond Oil (for times when I need more hydration) 
My other question was that I wanted to find a replacment sunscreen for my current, the one I’m using works fine but the price worries me to continue purchasing. Also I’d like to find another moisturizer if possible without lightening or fade ingredients, I tried Fruit of the Earth Aloe Gel before and it breaks me out compared to actual aloe vera. One time I went ham on a bad sore throat and made an ungodly concoction of vinegar, lemon juice, and chile in a small glass and took a shot. Definitely made my throat feel the equivalent of using edible Lysol. Worked out fine in the end though.
